: Provenance: HAND-AUTHORED under SMA-317 (PR #33), not captured from the
: wire.
:
: Source of the shapes: not recorded. The SMA-317 design records only
: "Hand-authored — they double as wire-format documentation"
: (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-26-sma-317-anthropic-provider-design.md,
: line 465).
: The SMA-840 captures are from 2026-11-21. PR #33 merged on 2026-05-26. So
: the captures are not the source of this file.
:
: Later comparison with the SMA-840 transcriptions (2026-11-21). This is a
: comparison, not a source. The comparison set is two files in this directory
: from SMA-840 (PR #387): empty_thinking_tool_use.txt (run A,
: claude-sonnet-5-5) and thinking_text_tool_use.txt (run C,
: claude-sonnet-4-5). The two files have the same keys for each event type.
: The comparison inherits the edit lists in their headers. Nobody has checked
: those lists against a raw capture. For each event type in this file, every
: key is compared in both directions.
:
: - message_start: the captures also carry message.container,
:   message.stop_sequence, message.stop_details, message.diagnostics,
:   usage.cache_creation (with ephemeral_5m_input_tokens and
:   ephemeral_1h_input_tokens), usage.service_tier, usage.inference_geo and
:   usage.speed. This file has no key that the captures do not have. The
:   captures put model first in message. This file puts it after content. The
:   captures put cache_creation_input_tokens before cache_read_input_tokens.
:   This file has the opposite order. The captures send output_tokens 7 (run
:   A) and 3 (run C). This file sends 0.
: - content_block_start (tool_use): the captures also carry
:   "caller":{"type":"direct"}. The other keys and their order are the same.
: - input_json_delta: the keys are the same. The captures send a first delta
:   with "partial_json":"", then three fragments. This file sends the whole
:   input in one delta for each block.
: - content_block_stop and message_stop: the keys and their order are the
:   same.
: - message_delta: the captures also carry delta.stop_details,
:   delta.container, usage.input_tokens, usage.cache_creation_input_tokens,
:   usage.cache_read_input_tokens and usage.output_tokens_details
:   (thinking_tokens). This file carries only usage.output_tokens.
: - ping: each capture sends a ping event after its first content_block_start.
:   This file has no ping event.
: - Values: the id msg_02, the tool ids tu_a and tu_b, the tool names a and b,
:   the inputs and the token counts have no recorded source.
: - No capture: two tool_use blocks in sequence. Each capture has one tool_use
:   block.
: - No capture: a turn with no text block. Each capture has a text block
:   before its tool_use block.
: - No capture: a turn without thinking. Both captures start with a thinking
:   block.
